title: 第一卷 第21章 妖女的逆袭第一卷 第22章 把她也变成女奴
slug: 百岁成魔开局拿捏妖女命脉

两人走出山洞时，发现外面已经是半夜了。
花弄影看向李寒山：“主人，离子时还有一点时间，要不要再探索一下。”
李寒山看了一眼挂在天上的明月，问道：“弄影，你可知这秘境的来历？”
花弄影点点头，道：“这个秘境是各大宗门合力建造的，每个宗门各自掌握着一个入口，专门用于炼气弟子每三年一次的大考。”
原来如此。
这几个宗门不愧是魔宗，对自己宗门的弟子狠，对其它宗门的弟子更狠，互相都将对方的弟子当成了磨刀石。
花弄影接着道：“既然是专门为炼气弟子准备的试炼场，里面自然也不会有特别珍贵的灵药。那些真正的好东西，早就被搜刮干净了。除非......”
“除非什么？”
“除非能找到一些漏网之鱼。”
花弄影轻笑着解释：“秘境存在了数百年，每次开启都会有弟子在里面留下一些种子，或者有些灵药生长在偏僻角落，没有被发现。日积月累，偶尔也会出现一两株珍品。不过这种概率太小了，碰上了是运气，碰不上也正常。”
李寒山倒是没指望获得太珍贵的灵药，但还是决定趁最后一点时间，把差的几十积分补齐。
“搞定！”
小半时辰后，一处山谷里，倒了一地的妖兽尸体。
飞剑化为的寒光绕了一个圈，重新回到李寒山身边，被他收了起来。
至此，一千积分凑够了。
他这个内门弟子是稳稳的了。
“主人的御剑术当真厉害。”
花弄影看得异彩连连，以她的眼界，自然看出李寒山御剑术的高明。
这让李寒山在她的心目中，更添了几分神秘，被李寒山利用阴纹给控制了生死的郁闷与不甘，也在无形中淡化了些许。

毕竟，女人都是慕强的。
臣服于弱者是耻辱，若是强者，那反倒有可能是荣耀。就看这强者到底有多强。
“子时到了，可以离开了。”
李寒山看了一下时辰，拿出试炼令，准备离开。
这时，远处突然传来剧烈的灵力波动，伴随着妖兽的怒吼声。
“有人在战斗。”
“主人，要不要过去看看？”花弄影问。
“走！”
两人收敛气息，快速朝战斗的方向潜去。
飞过一座高山后，两人看到了战斗的双方。
一方是李寒山之前利用的黑衣女子，以及几个天魔宗弟子；另一方则是一头体型巨大的妖兽。
那妖兽通体漆黑，形如巨虎，却生着一对肉翼，每一次扑击都带着腥风血雨，地面被砸出一个个大坑。
“二阶中期妖兽，暗翼魔虎！”
花弄影压低声音，眼中闪过惊讶。
而在暗翼魔虎身后的一处垮掉的崖壁上，一株通体赤红的灵芝正散发着淡淡的光芒。那灵芝约有脸盆大小，叶片肥厚，脉络中仿佛有液体在流动，光是看着就能感受到其中蕴含的浓郁灵气。
“血玉灵芝！”
花弄影眼睛一亮：“这么大，怕是长了上百年，是真正的天材地宝！没想到这秘境里居然真有漏网之鱼！”
李寒山问：“值钱吗？”
“当然值钱，这玩意儿要是拿出去卖，少说可以卖几万灵石！”
花弄影说到这里，不由看向他，语气热切起来：“最关键的是，血玉灵芝是炼体的圣药，对主人刚好有用。”

李寒山心中一动。
先不说灵石的问题，就说血玉灵芝炼体的功效，就足以让他势在必得。

When the two walked out of the cave, they found that it was already midnight outside.
Hua Nongying looked at Li Hanshan: "Master, I still have a little time, do you want to explore some more."
Li Hanshan glanced at the bright moon hanging in the sky and asked, "Nongying, do you know the origin of this secret realm?"
Hua Nongying nodded and said: "This secret realm was built by the joint efforts of all the major sects. Each sect has its own entrance, which is specially used for the major examination of Qi Refining disciples every three years."
That’s it.
These sects are worthy of being demon sects. They are ruthless to the disciples of their own sect, and even more ruthless to the disciples of other sects. Each of them treats the other's disciples as whetstones.
Hua Nongying continued: "Since it is a training ground specially prepared for Qi refining disciples, there will naturally be no particularly precious elixirs in it. Those really good things have been looted long ago. Unless..."
"Unless what?"
"Unless we can find some fish that slipped through the net."
Hua Nongying explained with a chuckle: "The secret realm has existed for hundreds of years. Every time it is opened, disciples will leave some seeds inside, or some elixirs grow in remote corners without being discovered. Over time, one or two treasures will occasionally appear. However, the probability is too small. It is luck to encounter it, and it is normal not to chance it."
Li Hanshan didn't expect to get the precious elixir, but he decided to take advantage of the last moment to make up the difference of dozens of points.
"Done!"
Half an hour later, in a valley, the corpses of monster beasts fell on the ground.
The cold light transformed from the flying sword circled around and returned to Li Hanshan, where he put it away.
At this point, one thousand points is enough.
As an inner disciple, he is stable.
"My master's sword control skills are really great."
Hua Nongying was fascinated by what she saw. From her perspective, she could naturally see Li Hanshan's mastery of swordsmanship.
This made Li Hanshan even more mysterious in her mind, and the depression and unwillingness of Li Hanshan using the Yin Pattern to control life and death also faded a little invisibly.
After all, women are all about being strong.
Surrendering to the weak is a shame, but if you are a strong person, it may be an honor. It depends on how strong this strong man is.
"It's midnight, you can leave."
Li Hanshan looked at the time, took out the trial order, and prepared to leave.
At this time, violent spiritual power fluctuations suddenly came from the distance, accompanied by the roar of the monster beast.
"Someone is fighting."
"Master, do you want to go over and take a look?" Hua Nongying asked.
"Let's go!"
The two of them gathered their breath and quickly dived in the direction of the battle.
After flying over a high mountain, the two saw both sides of the battle.
On one side was the woman in black that Li Hanshan had used before, and several disciples of the Heavenly Demon Sect; on the other side was a huge monster.
The demonic beast was pitch black, shaped like a giant tiger, but had a pair of fleshy wings. Every time it struck, it was filled with blood and blood, and large craters were made on the ground.
"Second-level mid-level monster, Dark Winged Demon Tiger!"
Hua Nongying lowered her voice, surprise flashed in her eyes.
On a collapsed cliff behind the Dark Wing Demon Tiger, a red Ganoderma lucidum was emitting a faint light. The Ganoderma lucidum is about the size of a washbasin, with thick leaves, and liquid seems to be flowing in the veins. You can feel the rich spiritual energy contained in it just by looking at it.
"Blood Jade Ganoderma!"
Hua Nongying's eyes lit up: "It's so big, I'm afraid it has grown for hundreds of years. It's a real treasure! I didn't expect that there would be a fish that slipped through the net in this secret realm!"
Li Hanshan asked: "Is it valuable?"
"Of course it's valuable. If this thing were sold, it could be sold for tens of thousands of spiritual stones!"
When Hua Nongying said this, she couldn't help but look at him, and her tone became eager: "The most important thing is that Blood Jade Ganoderma is a holy medicine for body refining, and it is just useful for the master."
Li Hanshan's heart moved.
Let’s not talk about the problem of spirit stones. Just talk about the body-refining effect of blood jade and lingzhi, which is enough for him to win it.
